categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Great Power Energy and Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the lithium-ion battery industry, including lithium-ion batteries, primary batteries (such as lithium iron, lithium manganese, and zinc-air batteries), and sodium-ion batteries. Its products serve energy storage, new energy vehicles, light power, and consumer electronics sectors. The company also engages in battery system integration and energy management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced battery technologies including high-energy-density lithium-ion cells, large-capacity cylindrical cells with full tab technology, LTSC low-temperature platform, and solid-state batteries with inorganic ceramic electrolytes. Manufacturing employs automated and digitalized processes with MES management, achieving up to 95% automation in energy storage cell production. R&D emphasizes materials, structure, and system innovations, supported by collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in renewable energy storage, electric vehicles (including two-wheelers, commercial vehicles, and drones), consumer electronics (such as Bluetooth audio devices and e-cigarettes), and light electric power applications. Major markets are China, the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, South America, and emerging markets in the Middle East and Africa. The company serves both domestic and international clients with a focus on large-scale energy storage and industrial/commercial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangzhou, Zhuhai, Changzhou, Liuzhou, Foshan, Quzhou, and Vietnam. It has established overseas offices in the US, Germany, Spain, Turkey, Singapore, India, Indonesia, Japan, and Chile. The company exports products globally, including Europe, North America, Australia, Japan, Africa, and Belt and Road countries, and is expanding local production and integration facilities internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou Great Power Energy operates mainly in the midstream of the battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell manufacturing, battery pack assembly, and system integration. It sources raw materials such as cathode, anode, electrolyte, and separators from upstream suppliers and sells finished battery products and systems to downstream customers in energy storage, automotive, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation with strategic R&D in solid-state batteries, high-capacity large cells (600Ah+), full tab cylindrical cells, and sodium-ion battery technologies. It invests in flexible ultra-thin solid electrolytes, alkali metal anode electrolytes, battery life prediction models, and long-life lithium iron phosphate batteries. The firm aims to enhance safety, energy density, cycle life, and low-temperature performance, supporting global energy transition and carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithium-ion batteries, primary batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and integrated energy storage systems to manufacturers and end customers. The company also earns income from licensing and strategic partnerships, with a focus on product sales rather than subscription or service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned among the top global lithium-ion battery manufacturers, ranked in the top 10 worldwide for energy storage battery shipments and top 3 in China for residential energy storage batteries. It competes with leading Chinese and international battery producers, leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio, advanced technology platforms, and global manufacturing footprint to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 7.96 billion, a 14.83% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 252 million due to intensified market competition and cost pressures. Total assets reached RMB 16.87 billion, growing 7.66% from the previous year. The company maintains a large-scale operation with over 11,000 employees and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangzhou Great Power Energy emphasizes high safety, high energy efficiency, and long cycle life in its battery products. Its differentiated technologies include large-capacity cells with high energy density and fast charging, solid-state batteries with intrinsic safety, and comprehensive energy storage solutions. The company offers customized products and full lifecycle services, ensuring reliability and performance that meet stringent international standards, thereby creating strong customer trust and market leadership.
